text:
Alex: Quick heads-up — for the annual planning offsite next month I want to run a scenario-tabletop exercise focusing on scope negotiation and launch criteria.
Sam: love that. can we fold in a "customer swing" where folks play customer roles?
Maria: yes please. eng would like concrete acceptance gates to avoid scope creep.
Tia: suggested facilitation flow: 1) problem framing 2) 3x customer scenarios 3) constrained solutioning 4) tradeoff radar
Ben: timing? how long for the tabletop?
Alex: thinking 90 mins for the exercise + 30 for a decision retro. overall 2 hours slot.
Jordan: logistics: hybrid folks will be on zoom. need a whiteboard + breakout rooms.
Sam: prework ask: 2 slides max from each PM with "top risk" and "assumed customer outcome" — due 72h before.
Maria: can we get a short tech feasibility scoreboard template? like: [F, M, H] for effort and [E, M, H] for infra risk.
Alex: yes — I'll drop a template. idea is to force binary decisions: build, buy, or shelve.
planning-bot: Reminder: prework deadline set to 3 days before offsite. @Alex set to send template.
Alex: pasted agenda draft:
```
- 09:00 Intro & framing (10m)
- 09:10 Customer scenario #1 (30m)
- 09:45 Breakout: constrained designs (20m)
- 10:05 Tradeoff radar + engineering feasibility (20m)
- 10:25 Decision: recommended scope & launch criteria (20m)
- 10:45 Retro & action owners (15m)
```
Sam: suggest adding a "no-hero" rule: proposals must include an MVP and measurable success metric.
Ben: agree. also add an infra fallback plan to ensure graceful degradation if features miss targets.
Tia: who will play customers? volunteer list?
Jordan: I can take a couple of external-user personas, Sam can do enterprise buyer.
Maria: volunteer to be "SRE" persona for feasibility checks.
Alex: great. action items:
- Alex: finalize template + share (due in 48h)
- PMs: submit 2-slide prework (due 72h before)
- Sam + Jordan: customer role scripts (due 48h before)
- Maria: tech scoreboard template (due 36h before)
Tia: I'll book the room and zoom link, and reserve a side breakout whiteboard.
Sam: one more — please capture the decision rule up-front: threshold for "ship" vs "defer" (e.g., adoption>5% in pilot + <2w infra changes)
Alex: noted — will propose a default threshold and we can tweak on the day.
Ben: can we run a dry run with facilitators the week before? 30m should surface flow kinks.
Alex: yes, schedule dry run. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
